sources.label: App patches by Dudek, for use with Morphe.
sources.author: Dudek
patch_list: Extends the day-start sponsor sequence to 1000 offers, with 10 gems per completed reward. Preserves skipping and the final PNN2 close flow. Works with Skip rewarded ads.
Routes Google Play Games sign-in and player/server authorization through MicroG-RE 7.1.0+ and suppresses obsolete stock Play services update prompts. Requires app.revanced.android.gms.
Hides real-money storefront sections and cancels Google Play checkout. Keeps in-game currency exchanges and existing purchase processing. Requires a supported ARM64 Pizza build.
Completes the game's rewarded-video flow without playing an ad, keeping the requested placement and normal reward. Includes re-signed startup support.
